name: Doing Drugs
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of intoxication and behaviors associated with substance abuse, highlighting that wine and strong drink can deceive and lead to unwise actions (Proverbs 20:1). Believers are called to live honorably and avoid drunkenness and revelry, as these are works of the flesh that separate one from the kingdom of God (Romans 13:13; Galatians 5:19, 21). Instead of being controlled by excess, Christians are exhorted to be filled with the Spirit, embracing a life marked by holiness and self-control (Ephesians 5:18).
